newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes remain at slightly weaker ranges.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes remain at slightly weaker ranges.

text.p: NEW YORK, FEB 4 (REUTER) - U.S. cash crude prices maintained the status quo from Tuesday morning, trading weaker on an outright basis and slightly lower for grades.
Traders said movement in the domestic grade market has been quiet, with only a few confirmed trades. "There has been no change, people are staying away," a trader said.
Outright crudes have continued to feel pressure from the weakness in heating oil. Warmer temperatures and only modest expectations for draws in tonight's API report were blamed.
Forecasts called for a 2.6 million barrel draw in the distillates and a 2.2 million barrel build for crude.
